newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Asian man killed in Bahrain arson attack.
newsitem.headline: Asian man killed in Bahrain arson attack.

text.p: An arson attack in a Shi'ite village in Bahrain killed an Asian man and injured two other people, local newspapers reported on Thursday.
They quoted an Interior Ministry statement as saying eight masked men carried out the attack in the Tubli area, eight km (five miles) south of the capital Manama, on Tuesday evening.
"The men surrounded the building with car tyres and set them ablaze. They then threw molotov cocktails into the building, setting it on fire," the Gulf Daily News newspaper reported.

It named the victim as Abdul-Hameed Mohy Eldin, who was found dead in the building by fire fighters. It did not give his nationality, but said he was Asian. Two people were injured, the papers said without identifying them.

The attack appeared to be part of sporadic unrest among members of Bahrain's majority Shi'ite Moslem community seeking political and economic reforms from the Sunni-led government. Tuesday's fatality takes the death toll from two years of unrest to 28.
